dialogues.jp:
映画は――まあ、何と言うかよくも悪くも、
『ふつーの恋愛モノ』でしかなかった。
dialogues.en:
The movie-- well, it wasn't particularly good or bad, just a
typical romance movie.
dialogues.text:
The movie-- well, it wasn't particularly good or bad, just a
typical romance movie.

dialogues.jp: 大家の令嬢、そしてその恋人
dialogues.en:
All about the young daughter of a distinguished family, and
her lover.
dialogues.text:
All about the young daughter of a distinguished family, and
her lover.

dialogues.jp:
（まぁ、どうせ、二人は、しきたりなんかで結
　ばれない運命とかなんだろう）
dialogues.en: "(Of course, they were never meant to be together.)"
dialogues.text: "(Of course, they were never meant to be together.)"

dialogues.jp: そしてふたりは手に手を取って駆け落ち、
dialogues.en:
So, the two of them grasped each other's hands and ran away
together.
dialogues.text:
So, the two of them grasped each other's hands and ran away
together.

dialogues.jp:
（で、駆け落ちしたのはいいもののどちらかが
　倒れるわけだ）
dialogues.en:
"(And when something like that happens, one of them has to
collapse just to up the drama meter.)"
dialogues.text:
"(And when something like that happens, one of them has to
collapse just to up the drama meter.)"

dialogues.jp:
重い病にかかった令嬢は恋人の腕の中で息を引
き取った。
dialogues.en: The extremely sick girl had collapsed in her lover's arms.
dialogues.text: The extremely sick girl had collapsed in her lover's arms.

dialogues.jp: （……俺、こういう話って嫌いなんだよなぁ）
dialogues.en:
"(...Maybe I really am a pretty horrible person if I think
of it this way...)'
dialogues.text:
"(...Maybe I really am a pretty horrible person if I think
of it this way...)'

dialogues.jp:
話を人の死に絡めて泣かせ系に仕立てあげよう
としている意図はわかった。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I understand that the movie was intentionally
made this way to get people to cry over it.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I understand that the movie was intentionally
made this way to get people to cry over it.

dialogues.jp:
しかしこの、皆まで見なくとも先の読める展開
と。作り手の、泣かせようとする見え見えの魂
胆はなんなんだ。
dialogues.en:
But we've barely seen anything of why it came to be this
way. All the people around are crying without knowing the
situation.
dialogues.text:
But we've barely seen anything of why it came to be this
way. All the people around are crying without knowing the
situation.

dialogues.jp: （……おまけに周りはカップルばかりだし）
dialogues.en: "(...And there really are a lot of couples.)"
dialogues.text: "(...And there really are a lot of couples.)"

dialogues.jp: いかん、別の意味で泣きたくなってきた。
dialogues.en: Crap, now I'm going to cry for another reason.
dialogues.text: Crap, now I'm going to cry for another reason.

dialogues.jp: 「……あーこりゃこりゃ」
dialogues.en: "...Arghargh."
dialogues.text: "...Arghargh."

dialogues.jp:
やりきれなくなって意味もなく呟いてみたりす
る。
dialogues.en:
I muttered incoherently, trying to drive that thought from
my head.
dialogues.text:
I muttered incoherently, trying to drive that thought from
my head.

dialogues.jp:
……改めて工藤のセンスに疑問を感じざるをえ
ない。
dialogues.en: ...I really have to question Kudou's sense of taste.
dialogues.text: ...I really have to question Kudou's sense of taste.

dialogues.jp:
俺だったらいくら割引券をもらおうがこんなコ
テコテの映画を、しかも男友達と一緒に見たい
なんて絶対思わんぞ。
dialogues.en:
There's no way that two guys would want to watch this kind
of mushy movie together.
dialogues.text:
There's no way that two guys would want to watch this kind
of mushy movie together.

dialogues.jp: その時だった。
dialogues.en: Then.
dialogues.text: Then.

dialogues.jp: クスン、と小さく｛はな／洟｝をすする音が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: I heard a soft, yet audible sob.
dialogues.text: I heard a soft, yet audible sob.

dialogues.jp: 何気なく隣を見る。――と。
dialogues.en: I casually looked to my side, to see...
dialogues.text: I casually looked to my side, to see...

dialogues.jp: （にゃ、にゃにおぅぅぅぅう！！？？）
dialogues.en: "(W, what the heeeeeeell!!??)"
dialogues.text: "(W, what the heeeeeeell!!??)"

dialogues.jp:
工藤が力いっぱい映画に感化され、ぼろぼろ涙
をこぼしているではないか。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's attention was fully focused on the screen, not even
noticing the tears running from his eyes.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's attention was fully focused on the screen, not even
noticing the tears running from his eyes.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと待てお前、いくらなんでもそりゃあな
いだろう……。
dialogues.en: Wait a minute, you, how long have you been like this...
dialogues.text: Wait a minute, you, how long have you been like this...

dialogues.jp: 「く、工藤君？」
dialogues.en: "K, Kudou-kuuun?"
dialogues.text: "K, Kudou-kuuun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Sniff.... Asakura....."
dialogues.text: "Sniff.... Asakura....."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: （ぉぃぉぃおいおいおいおい！！！！！）
dialogues.en: "(Oy oy OYOYOYOYOYOY!!)"
dialogues.text: "(Oy oy OYOYOYOYOYOY!!)"

dialogues.jp:
あろうことかあるまいことか、工藤は俺にすが
りついて泣き始めた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou clinged onto my arm, tears still streaming down his
face.
dialogues.text:
Kudou clinged onto my arm, tears still streaming down his
face.

dialogues.jp:
幸い周りはいちゃつくカップルばかりで俺達の
薔薇薔薇な雰囲気に気付く人間はいない。
dialogues.en:
There wasn't a single person around who wasn't noticing our
"intimate" moment.
dialogues.text:
There wasn't a single person around who wasn't noticing our
"intimate" moment.

dialogues.jp: だが、これは新手の拷問だぞ。
dialogues.en: Now I'm put through a new kind of torture...
dialogues.text: Now I'm put through a new kind of torture...

dialogues.jp: （頼む……頼むから早く終わってくれぇぇ）
dialogues.en: "(Please... please let this end alreadyyyy...)"
dialogues.text: "(Please... please let this end alreadyyyy...)"

dialogues.jp:
エンドロールが流れるまでの数分間、俺は生き
た心地もしなかった。
dialogues.en: Until the credits roll, I won't be able to live again...
dialogues.text: Until the credits roll, I won't be able to live again...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「た、頼むから……いい加減泣き止め」
dialogues.en: "C, come on... stop crying already."
dialogues.text: "C, come on... stop crying already."

dialogues.jp:
そして……映画館を出ても、まだ工藤は泣き止
んでいなかった。
dialogues.en: When we finally left the theater... Kudou was still crying.
dialogues.text: When we finally left the theater... Kudou was still crying.

dialogues.jp:
道を行き交う通行人たちの、好奇の視線がびし
びし伝わってきて、たいへんにツラい。
dialogues.en:
The weird looks and funny smiles that the passers-by were
giving us were killing me.
dialogues.text:
The weird looks and funny smiles that the passers-by were
giving us were killing me.

dialogues.jp: （な、泣きたいのはこっちだ……）
dialogues.en: "(T, the one crying should be me...)"
dialogues.text: "(T, the one crying should be me...)"

dialogues.jp:
一緒に大声で泣いてやろうかとも思ったが、さ
すがにそれはやめておく。
dialogues.en:
I felt like yelling out in tears, but quickly decided
against it.
dialogues.text:
I felt like yelling out in tears, but quickly decided
against it.

dialogues.jp:
「……お前、これは新手の拷問なのか？　そう
　なんだな？」
dialogues.en:
"...You really love finding new ways to torture me, don't
you?"
dialogues.text:
"...You really love finding new ways to torture me, don't
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Hic....... s, sorry..."
dialogues.text: "Hic....... s, sorry..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「と、とにかくあっち行こうぜ、あっち」
dialogues.en: "A, anyway, let's go over there."
dialogues.text: "A, anyway, let's go over there."

dialogues.jp:
俺はわたわたと、ひとけの少ないところへ場所
を移した。
dialogues.en: I hurriedly shooed Kudou to a less crowded place.
dialogues.text: I hurriedly shooed Kudou to a less crowded place.

dialogues.jp:
ようやく工藤も涙が治まったようで、俺はやれ
やれと胸を撫で下ろした。
dialogues.en:
I finally managed to get Kudou to stop crying. I sighed,
patting my chest.
dialogues.text:
I finally managed to get Kudou to stop crying. I sighed,
patting my chest.

dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……知ってる奴に見られたらと思うと気
　が気じゃなかったぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Haah... if I knew you were going to be like that, I
wouldn't have wanted to go..."
dialogues.text:
"Haah... if I knew you were going to be like that, I
wouldn't have wanted to go..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あはは、ごめんな」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha, sorry."
dialogues.text: "Ahaha, sorry."

dialogues.jp:
赤い目をした工藤は何事もなかったようにけろ
りと笑う。
dialogues.en: The red-eyed Kudou laughed as if nothing wrong happened."
dialogues.text: The red-eyed Kudou laughed as if nothing wrong happened."

dialogues.jp: 「ゴメンで済むか！　ったく……」
dialogues.en: "Is that all you have to say! Geez..."
dialogues.text: "Is that all you have to say! Geez..."

dialogues.jp:
しかしながら、あんな恥ずかしいシーンで泣け
る精神構造は全くもって理解が出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I really don't understand how he could keep on crying
despite that horribly embrassing situation.
dialogues.text:
I really don't understand how he could keep on crying
despite that horribly embrassing situation.

dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……隣の館でやってた、ホラー映画見れ
　ば良かった……」
dialogues.en:
"Sigh... we should've gone to the othet theater, the one
showing the horror movie.."
dialogues.text:
"Sigh... we should've gone to the othet theater, the one
showing the horror movie.."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「え！？　ダメダメ、俺怖いの全っ然ダメなん
　だよ！」
dialogues.en: "Eh!? No, I can't! I hate scary things!"
dialogues.text: "Eh!? No, I can't! I hate scary things!"

dialogues.jp:
ホラーという単語を聞いただけで、工藤は顔色
を変えてぶんぶん首を振る。
dialogues.en:
Just from the word "horror", his face turned pale and he
shook his head from side to side vigourously.
dialogues.text:
Just from the word "horror", his face turned pale and he
shook his head from side to side vigourously.

dialogues.jp: 「ダメダメだな工藤……」
dialogues.en: "You can't eh, Kudou..."
dialogues.text: "You can't eh, Kudou..."

dialogues.jp:
よし、あんなぬるい恋愛ものじゃなくて、今度
とびきりのホラー映画で、工藤を鍛え直してや
る！
dialogues.en:
Hm, I have to fix this reversal in ideals. I'd have to force
him to watch a horror movie next time to get used to it.
dialogues.text:
Hm, I have to fix this reversal in ideals. I'd have to force
him to watch a horror movie next time to get used to it.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり｛おとこ／漢｝はホラーだろ！
dialogues.en: After all, men are all about horrors!
dialogues.text: After all, men are all about horrors!

dialogues.jp:
……ホラー映画にこいつを連れて行ったとして、
万一「キャー」なんて抱きつかれた日には、周
囲の人間にさらなる誤解を……。
dialogues.en:
...If he watches a horror movie, I'd bet he'd scream and
grab onto my arm, and the people around will misunderstand
again...
dialogues.text:
...If he watches a horror movie, I'd bet he'd scream and
grab onto my arm, and the people around will misunderstand
again...

dialogues.jp: 「いかんいかん、それだけはいかんぞ！」
dialogues.en: "No no no, not again!"
dialogues.text: "No no no, not again!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そこ、なにを自己完結してる？」
dialogues.en: "So, what are you thinking to yourself about this time?"
dialogues.text: "So, what are you thinking to yourself about this time?"

dialogues.jp:
わしゃわしゃと頭を｛か／掻｝きむしる俺に、工藤は不
思議そうな視線を投げかけてくる。
dialogues.en:
Kudou was looking at me curiously, as I had my head in my
hands.
dialogues.text:
Kudou was looking at me curiously, as I had my head in my
hands.

dialogues.jp: 「あー……まぁこっちのことだ、気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Ah... just thinking about just now, don't mind me."
dialogues.text: "Ah... just thinking about just now, don't mind me."

dialogues.jp:
どっと疲れた俺は、そういえば今日起きてから、
何も口にしていなかった事を思い出した。
dialogues.en:
Just the thought of it made me tired. I then remembered that
I hadn't eaten anything since I woke up.
dialogues.text:
Just the thought of it made me tired. I then remembered that
I hadn't eaten anything since I woke up.

dialogues.jp: 「……で、メシは？」
dialogues.en: "...How about grabbing some food now?"
dialogues.text: "...How about grabbing some food now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「え？　メシ？　なんの話だ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Food? What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Food? What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「工藤、てめっ！」
dialogues.en: "Kudou, you...!"
dialogues.text: "Kudou, you...!"

dialogues.jp:
すっとぼけようとする工藤に激しい裏拳の、ツッ
コミを入れる。
dialogues.en: Kudou's boke act brought out the tsukkomi in me.
dialogues.text: Kudou's boke act brought out the tsukkomi in me.

dialogues.jp:
「おごる約束だろ！　それがなきゃ誰が野郎と
　二人で恋愛映画なんか観に来るか！！」
dialogues.en:
"You promised to treat me! Who would go with some idiot to a
romance movie if that offer wasn't there!"
dialogues.text:
"You promised to treat me! Who would go with some idiot to a
romance movie if that offer wasn't there!"

dialogues.jp:
ここで飯までおあずけと来たら、俺はただ恥を
かかされるためだけに外出したことになるでは
ないか。
dialogues.en:
If I didn't at least get some food out of this, all my shame
earlier would've been for nothing.
dialogues.text:
If I didn't at least get some food out of this, all my shame
earlier would've been for nothing.

dialogues.jp: そんな事があっていいのか？　否！　良くない！
dialogues.en: Is that fine? NO, it isn't!
dialogues.text: Is that fine? NO, it isn't!

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは、冗談冗談」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha, I'm just kidding."
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha, I'm just kidding."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「俺のよく行く店なんだけどさ。ファミレスだ
　けど、いいよな？」
dialogues.en: "Mind if I take us to a family restaurant I go to often?"
dialogues.text: "Mind if I take us to a family restaurant I go to often?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい、口に入るものでしたらモルチュン
　でもムックリでも」
dialogues.en:
"Fine fine, as long as I won't have a Jew's Harp in my
mouth."
dialogues.text:
"Fine fine, as long as I won't have a Jew's Harp in my
mouth."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだ、そりゃ」
dialogues.en: "...What's that supposed to mean."
dialogues.text: "...What's that supposed to mean."

dialogues.jp:
そんな訳で俺は工藤に連れられて赤い瓦屋根の
和食系ファミレスに入った。
dialogues.en:
He lead us to a traditional Japanese-style family
restaurant, with a red-tiled roof.
dialogues.text:
He lead us to a traditional Japanese-style family
restaurant, with a red-tiled roof.

dialogues.jp: 店内では上品な琴のＢＧＭが流れている。
dialogues.en:
The elegant playing of a koto made up the background music
inside.
dialogues.text:
The elegant playing of a koto made up the background music
inside.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに｛みやび／雅｝な雰囲気だなと思って聞いていると
何のことはない、最近のヒットチャートのアレ
ンジだった。
dialogues.en:
It fit the ambience of the restaurant, despite the tune
being a recent hit song.
dialogues.text:
It fit the ambience of the restaurant, despite the tune
being a recent hit song.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「三色御膳、ミニ白玉パフェつきお願いします」
dialogues.en:
"I'd have the three-tray meal, and a mini-rice parfait
please."
dialogues.text:
"I'd have the three-tray meal, and a mini-rice parfait
please."

dialogues.jp:
メニューを広げてあれこれ迷った末に、やたら
と可愛げのあるものをオーダーする工藤。
dialogues.en:
He spread out the menu, and pointed out what he wanted in a
cute fashion.
dialogues.text:
He spread out the menu, and pointed out what he wanted in a
cute fashion.

dialogues.jp: 「俺、カツ煮御膳」
dialogues.en: "I'd have the cooked katsu."
dialogues.text: "I'd have the cooked katsu."

dialogues.speaker: Waitress
dialogues.jp: 「かしこまりました」
dialogues.en: "Certainly."
dialogues.text: "Certainly."

dialogues.jp:
俺はメニューを下げる着物エプロンの店員を
ぼーっと見送った。和食の店らしく店員の制
服も全員大正浪漫風スタイルだ。
dialogues.en:
My eyes wandered to the kimono apron of the waitress. All
the employees in the store were dressed in uniforms
romancing the Taisho era.
dialogues.text:
My eyes wandered to the kimono apron of the waitress. All
the employees in the store were dressed in uniforms
romancing the Taisho era.

dialogues.jp: （眼福、眼福）
dialogues.en: "(Ahh, my eyes are blessed today.)"
dialogues.text: "(Ahh, my eyes are blessed today.)"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なーにデレデレしてんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You've got that lovestruck look in your eyes."
dialogues.text: "You've got that lovestruck look in your eyes."

dialogues.jp: 呆れているのか、なんか不機嫌な声を出す工藤。
dialogues.en:
Kudou voiced out a surprising amount of displeasure in his
words.
dialogues.text:
Kudou voiced out a surprising amount of displeasure in his
words.

dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ……やっぱ和装の女の子って、いいよ
　な、と思って」
dialogues.en: "Naah... just thinking, girls really look good in a kimono."
dialogues.text: "Naah... just thinking, girls really look good in a kimono."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、着物フェチの気があったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, do you have a kimono fetish?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, do you have a kimono fetish?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……ヘンな言い方すんな。まぁ確かに着物の
　女の子っていうのは、いいと思うけどさ」
dialogues.en:
"...Don't jump to conclusions. But well, girls really do
look good in a kimono."
dialogues.text:
"...Don't jump to conclusions. But well, girls really do
look good in a kimono."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「うむ。なんというか、こう、可憐な中にも凛
　とした涼しさがあってだな……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. How do you say it, it gives off a cute, yet cool and
calm air..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. How do you say it, it gives off a cute, yet cool and
calm air..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「日本男児ならば和装美少女を愛でるのが道と
　いうものではないかと」
dialogues.en:
"A girl in a kimono will always be able to find her path
into a Japanese man's heart."
dialogues.text:
"A girl in a kimono will always be able to find her path
into a Japanese man's heart."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なーにが道だよ」
dialogues.en: "What kind of path is that!"
dialogues.text: "What kind of path is that!"

dialogues.jp: 熱く語る俺に苦笑をもらす工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou laughed at my passionate speech.
dialogues.text: Kudou laughed at my passionate speech.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「でも………………よかったな」
dialogues.en: "But... that's good."
dialogues.text: "But... that's good."

dialogues.jp: なにがいいんだ？
dialogues.en: What's good?
dialogues.text: What's good?

dialogues.speaker: Waitress
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせ致しました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for waiting."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for waiting."

dialogues.speaker: Waitress
dialogues.jp: 「お、来た来た」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, here it comes."
dialogues.text: "Ohh, here it comes."

dialogues.jp: 店員が慣れない手つきで固形燃料に着火する。
dialogues.en: The waitress skillfully ignited the cooker on our table.
dialogues.text: The waitress skillfully ignited the cooker on our table.

dialogues.jp:
ほどなく小さな鍋のなかで俺のカツとじがぐつ
ぐつ煮えだした。
dialogues.en: She placed a small pot of my katsu to simmer on it.
dialogues.text: She placed a small pot of my katsu to simmer on it.

dialogues.jp: 「おー、旨そ♪」
dialogues.en: "Ooh, looks good♪"
dialogues.text: "Ooh, looks good♪"

dialogues.jp:
半煮えの卵がダシと衣の上で泡をたてる。食欲
をそそる甘い匂いが立ち上って、俺は思わず喉
を鳴らした。
dialogues.en:
The half-cooked egg was foaming with steam bubbles. The
appetizing smell made my mouth water.
dialogues.text:
The half-cooked egg was foaming with steam bubbles. The
appetizing smell made my mouth water.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「よりによって一番高いもん頼みやがって」
dialogues.en: "...My order better arrive soon."
dialogues.text: "...My order better arrive soon."

dialogues.jp: 俺の鍋に恨めしそうな視線を送る工藤。
dialogues.en: His longing stares at my simmering pot was a dead giveaway.
dialogues.text: His longing stares at my simmering pot was a dead giveaway.

dialogues.jp:
「悪く思うな、金を出してくれるとあらば骨ま
　でしゃぶり尽くせ、というのが朝倉家の家訓
　なのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, but it's an Asakura tradition to suck dry every
offer that comes our way."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, but it's an Asakura tradition to suck dry every
offer that comes our way."

dialogues.jp:
俺は適当なことを言いながら、上機嫌で箸を割っ
た。
dialogues.en: I merrily replied as I ripped apart my chopsticks.
dialogues.text: I merrily replied as I ripped apart my chopsticks.

dialogues.en: "...Hmmm."
dialogues.text: "...Hmmm."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何見てんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Ehn? What are you looking at?"
dialogues.text: "Ehn? What are you looking at?"

dialogues.jp:
食事中、何気なく視線をあげた俺はふと手をと
めた。
dialogues.en: In the middle of our meal, my eyes started wandering around.
dialogues.text: In the middle of our meal, my eyes started wandering around.

dialogues.jp:
「いや……お前って随分お上品な食べ方するん
　だな〜と思って」
dialogues.en:
"Hrm... just noticing that the way you eat is very elegant
and polite."
dialogues.text:
"Hrm... just noticing that the way you eat is very elegant
and polite."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そ……そうか？」
dialogues.en: "I... is that so?"
dialogues.text: "I... is that so?"

dialogues.jp: 照れくさそうな工藤に大きく頷いてみせる。
dialogues.en:
Kudou bowed his head in slight embarassment, concentrating
on his food.
dialogues.text:
Kudou bowed his head in slight embarassment, concentrating
on his food.

dialogues.jp:
お膳が運ばれてくると、まず工藤は丁寧に箸で
魚の皮と小骨を外したのだ。
dialogues.en:
When his food arrived, he conscientously used his chopsticks
to remove every bone from the fish and place it in another
tray.
dialogues.text:
When his food arrived, he conscientously used his chopsticks
to remove every bone from the fish and place it in another
tray.

dialogues.jp:
それも見苦しくないようにきちんと皿の脇に取
り除けて。
dialogues.en:
Any other unsightly or inedible things were moved to the
side of the plate.
dialogues.text:
Any other unsightly or inedible things were moved to the
side of the plate.

dialogues.jp:
「お椀や箸の持ち方もミョ〜にみやびやかだし。
　ひょっとしてお前んちって、代々続く老舗と
　かだったりすんのか？」
dialogues.en:
"The way you hold your chopsticks and bowl is so refined as
well. Is that something passed down through your family?"
dialogues.text:
"The way you hold your chopsticks and bowl is so refined as
well. Is that something passed down through your family?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ばあちゃんが厳しかったから、自然と身につ
　いちまったんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"My grandmother is incredibly strict, so it just comes
naturally."
dialogues.text:
"My grandmother is incredibly strict, so it just comes
naturally."

dialogues.jp:
俺なんか、音夢にいくら口やかましく言われて
もいっこうに直らない癖がいくつもあるのだが。
dialogues.en:
No matter how many times Nemu lectures me, I doubt she'd be
able to cure any of my bad habits.
dialogues.text:
No matter how many times Nemu lectures me, I doubt she'd be
able to cure any of my bad habits.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「って言うか、朝倉がなってなさすぎるだけな
　んだって。その歳になって箸もちゃんと持て
　ないのはみっともないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Speaking of that, you're basically the opposite. Not
knowing how to hold chopsticks at that age is pretty
embarassing."
dialogues.text:
"Speaking of that, you're basically the opposite. Not
knowing how to hold chopsticks at that age is pretty
embarassing."

dialogues.jp: 呆れたように俺の手元を指差す工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou pointed at my chopstick-holding hand in amazement.
dialogues.text: Kudou pointed at my chopstick-holding hand in amazement.

dialogues.jp:
俺は未だに箸の正式な持ち方――二本ある上の
ほうだけを動かす、というやり方が呑み込めず
に、飯つぶをこぼしまくっていた。
dialogues.en:
The way I held my chopsticks gave no thought to elegance at
all, and just concnetrated on eating as quickly as possible.
dialogues.text:
The way I held my chopsticks gave no thought to elegance at
all, and just concnetrated on eating as quickly as possible.

dialogues.jp: 「……ほっとけ」
dialogues.en: "...Enough."
dialogues.text: "...Enough."

dialogues.jp:
……しかし、工藤のそんな言葉を少し気にした
俺は、散らばった米粒をいそいそと片付けたの
だった。
dialogues.en:
...Even though I said that, I started putting scattered
grains of rice in order.
dialogues.text:
...Even though I said that, I started putting scattered
grains of rice in order.

dialogues.jp: ◆恋愛映画と工藤◆
dialogues.en: ◆Romance Movies and Kudou◆
dialogues.text: ◆Romance Movies and Kudou◆

dialogues.jp:
工藤と映画に行った俺だが、何故か映画に感化
された工藤は、俺にすがりついて大泣き。
dialogues.en:
I went with Kudou to watch a movie. He was so influenced by
it that he clinged onto my arm, crying.
dialogues.text:
I went with Kudou to watch a movie. He was so influenced by
it that he clinged onto my arm, crying.

dialogues.jp:
傍から見ると、まるで野郎カップルのようで、
とても焦った俺だった。
dialogues.en: The looks that everyone else gave us burned me to the core.
dialogues.text: The looks that everyone else gave us burned me to the core.

dialogues.jp:
その後、工藤行きつけの和食系ファミレスで約
束どおり飯を｛おご／奢｝って貰ったのだった。
dialogues.en:
After that, Kudou brought me to a Japanese-style family
restaurant to fulfill his promise of treating me.
dialogues.text:
After that, Kudou brought me to a Japanese-style family
restaurant to fulfill his promise of treating me.

dialogues.jp:
いやぁ、しかし、なんというか、やはり着物は
ええですなぁ。
dialogues.en: Really, in the end, kimonos are great.
dialogues.text: Really, in the end, kimonos are great.
